origin: Phase 4 live Dell Agent authority_fences read failures
original_failure: A shared check_same_thread=False connection served writer, lease reader, status reader, reconciliation reader, checkpoint, and backup roles.

fixed_architecture.writer: one serialized writer connection with bounded lock acquisition
fixed_architecture.reader: one short-lived read-only connection and transaction per calling thread

required_invariants: Dell runtime source has no direct shared writer connection reads
critical reads return one committed WAL snapshot
SQLite uncertainty returns SAFE_BLOCKED and invalidates the process lease
checkpoint, backup, heartbeat, reconciliation, and status concurrency produce no KeyError or SQLite exception
agent restart never restores a persisted monotonic lease
